description_en: Call `QueryDomainByInstanceId` to retrieve the basic information of a domain name by instance ID

DomainGroupId.description_en: The ID of the domain name group. You can call the QueryDomainGroupList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.html) operation to obtain the ID of the domain name group

DomainNameVerificationStatus.description_en:

NONAUDIT: The domain name is not verified.

SUCCEED: The domain name is verified.

FAILED: The domain name fails to be verified.

AUDITING: The domain name is being verified

域名命名审核状态。取值：
NONAUDIT：未认证。
SUCCEED：成功。
FAILED：审核失败。
AUDITING：审核中。

DomainStatus.description_en:
The status of the domain name. Valid values:

2: The domain name needs to be redeemed.

3: The domain name is normal
DomainStatus.description_zh:
域名状态。取值：

1：急需续费。                                 
2：急需赎回。

The type of the domain name. Valid values:

New gTLD.

gTLD.

ccTLD

New gTLD。                                 
gTLD。

Email.description_en: The email address of the domain name registrant

EmailVerificationClientHold.description_en:

false: The DNS resolution for the domain name is not suspended.

true: The DNS resolution for the domain name is suspended

域名是否被暂停解析。取值：

true：域名已被暂停解析

EmailVerificationStatus.description_en:

域名持有者邮箱是否已通过验证。取值：
0：没有通过验证。

ExpirationCurrDateDiff.description_en: The number of days from the expiration date to the current date
ExpirationCurrDateDiff.description_zh: 域名到期日和当前的时间的天数差值

ExpirationDate.description_en: The expiration date of the domain name

ExpirationDateLong.description_en: The expiration timestamp of the domain name

ExpirationDateStatus.description_en:
The expiration status of the domain name. Valid values:

1: The domain name has not expired.

2: The domain name has expired
ExpirationDateStatus.description_zh:
域名过期状态。取值：
1：域名未过期。
2：域名已过期。

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the domain name

Premium.description_en:
Indicates whether the domain name is a premium domain name. Valid values:

true: a premium domain name.

false: not a premium domain name
Premium.description_zh:
是否是溢价词。取值：
true：溢价词。
false：非溢价词

RealNameStatus.description_en:
The real-name verification status of the domain name. Valid values:

NONAUDIT: The real-name verification is not performed.

SUCCEED: The real-name verification is successful.

FAILED: The real-name verification fails.

AUDITING: The real-name verification is in progress.

The real-name verification status of a domain name is a composite status of domain name review and real-name verification. The real-name verification of a domain name is successful only when both the domain name review and real-name verification are successful
RealNameStatus.description_zh:
域名实名认证状态。取值：
NONAUDIT：未实名认证。
SUCCEED：实名认证成功。
FAILED：实名认证审核失败。
AUDITING：实名认证审核中。

域名实名认证状态是域名命名审核和实名审核的组合状态，只有域名命名审核和实名审核均通过才算域名实名认证成功

RegistrantName.description_en: The name of the contact person

RegistrantOrganization.description_en: The registrant of the domain name

RegistrantType.description_en:
The type of the domain name registrant. Valid values:

1: an individual.

2: an enterprise
RegistrantType.description_zh:
域名注册联系人类型。取值：
1：个人。
2：企业。

RegistrantUpdatingStatus.description_en:
The status of the domain name registrant. Valid values:

PENDING: The information about the domain name registrant is being modified.

NORMAL: The information about the domain name registrant is not being modified
RegistrantUpdatingStatus.description_zh:
域名持有者修改状态。取值：
PENDING：域名持有者信息修改中。
NORMAL：正常
